description: Read and listen to English at your own pace with Lingfern. Practice offline, save your progress, and optionally sync through GitHub.
dictionary: Look up English words with Open English WordNet, explore definitions and save bookmarks. Download the dictionary for offline use.

about: Learn about Lingfern, its open-source software, learning resources, licensing and contact information.
